topics.topic: Actor attribution and storage for records generated during compound operations
questions: For each record produced inside `submit_implementation`, `try_implementation`, run advancement and effect processing, is the recorded actor the request actor or the kernel, especially for record models that currently name no actor?
Which records store the acting actor, and for run advancement is that actor the request initiator, the kernel, or the authority that permitted an effect?
Which actor must be recorded for each record produced by admission, an explicit try, run advancement, approval handling, resume and startup recovery, and where is that actor stored?

judgement.divergence: One implementer attributes every record created during a compound request to the request actor; another attributes automatic admission, execution and effect records to the kernel or effect authority. Owners and agents reading records and traces observe different provenance.
judgement.why: The texts require actor attribution but do not assign or store an actor consistently for each nested record.

topics.topic: Validation, parsing, joining, and Host derivation for service base URLs
questions: Which base-URL forms are valid, and what exact parsing and joining rule produces the request URL and `host` header for every accepted form?

Are userinfo, query, fragment and non-root path components allowed in api_base_url, are one or all trailing slashes removed, and how is the Host authority derived for IPv6 and default or explicit ports?
Which api_base_url forms are valid, and what exact URL results when it contains a path, query, fragment, user information or trailing slashes?

judgement.why: Exact URL parsing, normalization, joining and Host serialization are encoding and format decisions for State 6.

topics.topic: Deterministic bounded and credential-safe construction of failure_detail
questions: How is `failure_detail` deterministically derived from an arbitrary service error body while remaining valid bounded text and excluding the resolved credential value?
What exact text is stored for sandbox exceptions and HTTP error bodies, which end of an overlong detail is retained, and how are non-UTF-8 HTTP body bytes converted before UTF-8-boundary truncation?

judgement.why: The exact representation, decoding and truncation format of failure details belongs to State 6.

topics.topic: First-start creation and initialization behavior of open_store
questions: What does `store.open_store` do on a first installation or when some expected store components do not yet exist?
Does first start create and initialize the data directory and store, or refuse until an operator creates them?

quotes:
The data directory holds one SQLite database with every kernel record, a
   content-addressed area of value bytes and file fixtures named by digest, and
   the run spool, one subdirectory per run.
judgement.why: The unchanged passage already raised the first-start initialization question, and the reopening change did not touch or make that question matter.

topics.topic: Immutable resolution and pinning of manifest locations and revisions
questions: How does the kernel resolve and pin `manifest_revision` so edits at the same filesystem location cannot change what a running process reads?
Is manifest_location a checked-out immutable directory, a version-control repository requiring object lookup at manifest_revision, or another revision-addressable source?

quotes:
`manifest_location`, `manifest_revision`: where the platform manifest is read
  and the repository revision it is read at — read by every manifest reading
  (M10), so a record changes for the kernel only when the owner changes the
  configured revision;
judgement.why: The manifest revision-resolution mechanism was already unspecified in this unchanged passage, and the reopening change did not affect it.

topics.topic: Ingestion and raw-byte digest computation for file-backed values and trial fixtures
questions: How do the bytes of authored input and expected-output file fixtures enter `functions.add_trial_case`, and which caller computes and verifies their file facts before they are stored?

Which module operation computes the SHA-256 digest of raw file bytes for trial fixtures, sandbox file outputs, multipart request descriptions and SpooledFiles, since canonical_bytes and content_identity accept JSON values rather than arbitrary bytes?

judgement.why: The byte-bearing inputs, digest representation and module signatures are State 6 field-type and signature decisions.

topics.topic: Pagination guarantees when filtered lifecycle fields change between pages
questions: What happens when a record above the continuation position did not match the first page's status filter but changes to a matching status before the next page, or a previously returned record stops matching?
What guarantee applies when a lifecycle field used by the filter changes between pages?

quotes:
The continuation token is the
   store position of the last item returned; the next page starts below it, so a
   record added meanwhile never shifts, repeats or hides an item. Each page
   applies the filter to the records as they are at its own request: a record
   whose filtered field (a status) changes between pages leaves or enters the
   pages still to come, and the token stays valid when the record it names no
   longer matches.
judgement.why: The cursor remains positional while filtering is reevaluated for records below that cursor on each request.

topics.topic: Redaction or transformation of personal data in agent-visible approval previews
questions: How is an approval preview returned to an agent when personal-data inputs have been embedded in its URL, query parameters, JSON body or multipart value parts?
How is the built-request portion of an approval preview transformed for an agent when it embeds personal_data?

judgement.divergence: One implementer returns the exact built-request preview and thereby exposes personal data embedded in its URL, query or body; another replaces those embedded representations with digests and classes. An agent reading the approval observes the difference, and the owner’s confidentiality boundary is affected.
judgement.why: The general masking rule does not define how to transform a composite built-request preview that already embeds personal values.

topics.topic: Bounded stateless continuation representation for large repair views
questions: How is an arbitrarily large first-page implementation set represented in a bounded, stateless continuation token?

topics.topic: Constant schema requirements and identity-defining facts
questions: Must every constant request carry its own value_schema, and exactly which constant facts participate in validation and flow-version identity?

topics.topic: Credential-reference format, resolution, and unresolved-error rules
questions: What exactly is a credential reference, how is it resolved, and which file, encoding, size, symlink, permission and newline rules determine `credential_unresolved`?

topics.topic: Eligibility and ordering semantics for roll_back_slot targets
questions: What makes an implementation “earlier”: any admitted non-current implementation, one submitted before the current implementation, or one that previously held an activation?

topics.topic: Handling spool-ceiling refusal after receiving a service response
questions: How must effects.reach_operation_element handle store.spool_file refusing a service file because of a spool ceiling?

topics.topic: Identity and link invariants enforced by each store.record_change operation
questions: Exactly which identities and links must each named store change validate, and which failures are refused versus internal_error?

topics.topic: Mapping canonicalization failures from internal producers to surface errors
questions: How is a canonical_bytes refusal mapped when the invalid value comes from sandbox output, a service response, a manifest entry or another internal producer rather than directly from an MCP request?

topics.topic: Multipart Content-Disposition encoding or rejection rules for port names
questions: How are quotes, backslashes, non-ASCII characters and control characters in port names represented in multipart Content-Disposition, or are such port names refused for bindings that use multipart?

topics.topic: NodeExecution timestamps when execution or sending never begins
questions: What are started_at and ended_at for a NodeExecution when no execution or HTTP send began?

topics.topic: Ordering and precedence for an operation element's current conclusion
questions: When an element has several NodeExecutions, EffectAttempts and approvals after resumes or a not_applied resolution, which record order and precedence determine its current conclusion?

topics.topic: Persistence and repair source of truth for run outputs
questions: Are produced run outputs persisted fields of Run M19, a derived view of the trace, or a persisted cache; and if cached, how are discrepancies and crash-lagged outputs repaired?

topics.topic: Raw JSON parsing and duplicate-key rejection boundary for canonical_bytes
questions: Does canonical_bytes accept raw JSON bytes/text and perform duplicate-aware parsing, or does another surface parser reject duplicates before passing a parsed value?

topics.topic: Reporting corrupt or schema-incompatible stores from open_store
questions: How does open_store report a corrupt store or a store created by an incompatible schema version?

topics.topic: Representation used to measure stored-value and other value-size limits
questions: For stored_value_bytes_max and other value-size checks, is size the received JSON text, the RFC 8785 canonical bytes, decoded in-memory size, or another representation?

topics.topic: Timestamp semantics when an unknown EffectAttempt is later resolved
questions: When an unknown attempt is resolved later, does concluded_at retain the time it became unknown, change to the resolution time, or is a separate resolved_at required?

topics.topic: Typed distinction and hashing rules among content and request identities
questions: How does the operation distinguish a raw value digest, a StoredValue value_id, a content-record identity, a manifest-entry digest, a request_digest, a corpus digest and an idempotency key, whose hashed facts and list-order rules differ?

topics.topic: Whether bounded refusal reasons may be truncated
questions: May refusal reasons be truncated, or must every possible reason be constructed so it is already within the bound?

topics.topic: Whether multipart boundary changes invalidate an approval
questions: Does changing the multipart boundary between approval and sending invalidate the approval?

topics.topic: Whether record reads return complete records or only declared output fields
questions: Do get/read operations return the complete State 1 record, including identity, provenance and timestamps, or only the fields enumerated in each public operation's Outputs section?

topics.topic: Whether trial, repair, and inspection responses expose successful JSON values
questions: Do try, repair and inspection answers expose successful JSON output values, or only their digests and metadata?

topics.topic: Whether try_implementation durably persists state or only returns evidence
questions: Is trying an implementation a durable state-changing operation, or must its evidence be returned without persistence?

topics.topic: Which internal errors require kernel termination
questions: Must every request-level internal_error terminate the kernel after the response, or only stop_required?
